scenes.event: Anna meets with her friend Cao at a local café to discuss her upcoming dental procedure.
scenes.description: Anna sits at a small table by the window, sipping a latte and nervously fiddling with her phone. Cao, her close friend, joins her moments later, bringing a pastry and a warm smile. The atmosphere is cozy, with soft music playing and the hum of conversation in the background. Anna is trying to decide whether to ask her mother to help her post-surgery, while Cao offers support and reassurance.

characters.name: Anna Castillo
characters.description: A sensitive and anxious young woman in her early twenties, recently moved to Hilltop to live independently. She is struggling with a decision about dental surgery and needing support.; Early / Female, 25 years old; Occupation: Flight Attendant; Personality: Sensitive, Anxious, Delicate, Independent; Values: Autonomy, Family Support, Emotional Security; Interests: Personal Health, Independent Living, Decision Making; Experiences: Moving to a new city, Handling adult responsibilities, Seeking emotional support

characters.name: Cao Liang
characters.description: Supportive and empathetic friend of Anna's, recently moved to Hilltop and adjusting to city life; Male; Age: 27; Occupation: Dental hygienist; Personality: Compassionate, patient, observant; Values: Empathy, reliability, personal growth; Interests: Reading self-help books, baking, outdoor photography; Experiences: Moved from a small town to a bustling city for career opportunities, volunteered at a community mental health center, recently helped a close friend through a similar dental procedure.

characters.name: Lena
characters.description: A regular customer at the café, known for her warm personality and experience with dental procedures; Female; Age: 38; Occupation: Dental hygienist; Personality: Empathetic, observant, optimistic; Values: Compassion, reliability, personal care; Interests: Coffee culture, oral health education, gardening; Experiences: Recently underwent a root canal procedure, volunteers at a community dental clinic, has helped many patients through anxious dental visits.

actions.action: Expresses her hesitation about the tooth extraction and needing help afterward.
actions.dialogue: I just don’t know if I should ask my mom to come over. I want to be independent, but the thought of being alone for a few days after surgery makes me anxious.

actions.action: Reassures Anna and offers to help.
actions.dialogue: Hey, don’t worry. If you need help, I’m here. I can bring you soup and make sure you’re okay. You don’t have to do this alone.

actions.action: Shares her own experience with dental surgery and offers advice.
actions.dialogue: I had a tooth extraction last year, and I stayed with a friend for two days. It’s totally normal to feel uneasy, but having someone to help you for a little while can make a big difference.

actions.action: Considers the suggestions and asks a follow-up question.
actions.dialogue: Thanks, Lena. That does help. Cao, would you really be okay with staying with me for a few days? I know it’s a lot to ask.
Of course, Anna. That’s what friends are for. You’ll have both your independence and support. Just don’t hesitate to reach out.

scenes.plot: Anna is trying to make a decision about her dental surgery and whether to rely on her mother or ask for help from Cao, her friend. Lena, a stranger with similar experiences, offers insight that helps Anna feel more at ease. The conversation allows Anna to express her inner conflict and consider alternative solutions while maintaining her sense of autonomy.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore Anna’s values of autonomy and emotional security, as well as her experiences with seeking support and handling adult responsibilities. The dialogue highlights her delicate and anxious personality while also showing her desire to be independent.
